finding: The M4/16GB machine and 12GB project cap support processed CRISPR matrices and source-paired API analysis, but not raw sequencing or whole-slide workflows.
All eight predeclared genes had 177 paired Broad/Sanger models; median gene-wise Spearman rho was 0.4222 and all correlations were positive.
The harmonized fc_clean_qn field is adequate for an engineering gate but not an untouched independent-replication endpoint.

Before WRN outcome access, the historical eligible colorectal cohort contained Broad 7 MSI/12 MSS, Sanger 10 MSI/19 MSS, and shared 6 MSI/7 MSS models; Broad failed the independent critic's proposed 8-per-class adequacy gate.
The preregistered processing-inflation hypothesis failed: median rho(fc_clean_qn)-rho(bf_scaled) was -0.0031 and only 4/8 genes favored fc_clean_qn, despite identical 177-model cohorts.

DepMap 26Q1 ScreenGeneEffect is explicitly library-corrected and is not a source-independent endpoint; 23Q4 source-separated naive scores are provenance-appropriate, but CRC-only Avana remains inadequate at 7 MSI models.

Broad Avana recovered the known MSI-WRN association across four tissues with stratified delta -0.7432, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.9377,-0.5019], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.
Held-out Sanger KY confirmed the MSI-WRN association with stratified delta -0.9307, 95% bootstrap CI [-1.0000,-0.8133], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.

Correction to the prior wording: KY is a sequentially gated confirmation contrast, not pristine unseen held-out values, because the first implementation parsed KY endpoints before the Avana gate. Numerical results and frozen gates were unchanged.

The four-tissue model-ordering design failed before outcome access: Endometrium had 5 overlapping Avana/KY models versus the independently frozen minimum of 8; no cross-source rank statistic was computed.
The preregistered two-tissue derived analysis passed: equal-tissue WRN rank agreement theta=0.5956, permutation p=13/100001, and paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.2636,0.8114].
Ordering reliability was heterogeneous: Large Intestine rho=0.8211 versus Ovary rho=0.3701.
10/34 paired models had absolute source-percentile gaps >=0.25; A2780 was the largest gap at 0.7448, making technical-versus-biological discordance the next target.
Audit corrected the bootstrap to retain frozen full-denominator percentiles without reranking duplicates; compliant 95% CI is [0.3186,0.7870], and the scientific pass is unchanged.

The preregistered five-metric source-QC-rank-asymmetry hypothesis failed: equal-tissue association with WRN percentile gap theta=-0.0662, one-sided permutation p=0.6452, and fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.3922,0.2780].
Tissue directions disagreed (Large Intestine rho=-0.2549; Ovary rho=0.1225), so broad screen-QC asymmetry does not provide a useful positive explanation of WRN ranking gaps in this frozen set.
All 34 paired models had zero annotated mutations across all four eligible Avana and five eligible KY WRN guide locations; source-asymmetry exposure was constant zero in both tissues.
The guide-site mutation candidate failed before outcome access; no WRN-gap association was computed, ruling out only variation in this specific official binary exposure for the frozen cohort.
